content: Collecting the same forms again? Save the space as a template to reuse its forms, folders and settings. Create the next space from it, then review who has access before collecting responses.

comment.text: Body of the Forms onboarding tour step that highlights the quick-action tile for creating a form space from a template, shown to admins.
